validity.recommendation: Material discrepancy in capacity and length specs (see contested field); verify against most recent Boardwalk 10-K
validity.researcher_notes: Gulf South Pipeline Company, LP is confirmed as a major FERC-certificated interstate natural gas transmission system owned by Boardwalk Pipeline Partners (subsidiary of Loews Corporation) operating between Texas and Alabama, serving southeastern U.S. markets. Boardwalk 2012 Annual Report describes system in detail: 'located along the Gulf Coast in the states of Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and Florida' with peak-day transmission capacity of 6.8 Bcf/d and 7,240 miles of pipeline. Material discrepancy identified: GEM recorded values (2700 MMcf/d capacity, 12070.08 km length) differ significantly from Boardwalk 2012 figures (6800 MMcf/d, 11650 km). Capacity difference is 152% (2700 vs 6800), length difference is 3.6% (12070 vs 11650). GEM values may reflect an earlier time period, different scope definition, or error. Operator confirmed: Gulf South Pipeline Company, LP. Owner confirmed: Boardwalk Pipeline Partners / Loews Corporation.
